flow_chart: Local QuerySynaptAgent: guardrail -> deterministic query parsing -> CSV/Chroma retrieval
RCAAgent: rank hypotheses against retrieved incident records
Frontend final answer: prediction section marked not_applicable; RCA and historical sections populated
DeepEval Retrieval: Contextual Precision + Contextual Recall + Contextual Relevancy + filter-compliance check
DeepEval RCA: GEval RCA Quality + Faithfulness (groundedness) + RCA evidence/caution check
DeepEval Final Answer: Answer Relevancy + Faithfulness + Hallucination
Persist aggregate and per-query metric scores

metric_definitions.Contextual Precision: Whether the retrieved contexts most relevant to the expected result rank highly.
metric_definitions.Contextual Recall: Whether retrieved contexts contain the information needed to satisfy the expected result.
metric_definitions.Contextual Relevancy: Whether retrieved context is relevant to the user query.
metric_definitions.Retrieval Filter Compliance: Deterministically checks each returned incident satisfies requested numeric and metadata filters.
metric_definitions.RCA Quality (GEval): LLM-judged quality, evidence use, uncertainty, and relevance of the RCA hypothesis.
metric_definitions.Faithfulness (RCA): Whether RCA claims are supported by the retrieved incident context.
metric_definitions.RCA Evidence and Caution: Deterministically checks ranked RCA output links to retrieved incidents and contains support.
metric_definitions.Answer Relevancy: Whether the final answer addresses the user query.
metric_definitions.Faithfulness (Final Answer): Whether final-answer claims are supported by retrieved context.
metric_definitions.Hallucination: Whether the final answer contains claims unsupported by the supplied context.
